itinerary.en: The travel agent will email you a full itinerary before you leave.
itinerary.zh: 旅行社会在你出发前把完整的行程表发邮件给你。

destination.en: Spain is still the most popular destination for our summer tours.
destination.zh: 西班牙仍然是我们夏季旅行团最受欢迎的目的地。

departure.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before your departure.
departure.zh: 请在出发前两小时到达机场。

arrival.en: Please check in at the reception desk on arrival at the hotel.
arrival.zh: 到达酒店后,请在前台办理入住。

reservation.en: I'd like to make a reservation for two nights in early May.
reservation.zh: 我想预订五月初的两晚住宿。

book.en: You should book your train tickets early to get a better price.
book.zh: 你应该早点预订火车票,这样价格更便宜。

confirm.en: Please call us two days before the trip to confirm your place.
confirm.zh: 请在出行前两天致电我们,确认你的名额。

cancellation.en: There's a small charge for any cancellation made after Friday.
cancellation.zh: 周五之后取消预订要收取少量费用。

refund.en: You can get a full refund if you cancel within seven days.
refund.zh: 七天内取消可以获得全额退款。

refund.en: The airline agreed to refund our tickets after the flight was cancelled.
refund.zh: 航班取消后,航空公司同意退还我们的机票钱。

brochure.en: This brochure lists all the hotels and day trips we offer.
brochure.zh: 这本宣传册列出了我们提供的所有酒店和一日游。

package-tour.en: A package tour usually includes your flights, hotel and some meals.
package-tour.zh: 跟团游通常包含机票、酒店和部分餐食。

excursion.en: There's an optional excursion to the old town on the third day.
excursion.zh: 第三天有一个去老城的自选短途游。

sightseeing.en: We spent the morning sightseeing and the afternoon relaxing on the beach.
sightseeing.zh: 我们上午观光,下午在海滩上放松。

guided-tour.en: The guided tour of the castle starts at eleven and lasts an hour.
guided-tour.zh: 城堡的导览游十一点开始,持续一小时。

backpacker.en: The town is popular with young backpackers because food and rooms are cheap.
backpacker.zh: 这个小镇很受年轻背包客欢迎,因为吃住都便宜。

hostel.en: We stayed in a cheap hostel with shared rooms near the bus station.
hostel.zh: 我们住在汽车站附近一家便宜的旅舍,房间是合住的。

bed-and-breakfast.en: We stayed at a small bed and breakfast run by a local couple.
bed-and-breakfast.zh: 我们住在一家由当地夫妇经营的小民宿。

campsite.en: The campsite has hot showers and a small shop near the entrance.
campsite.zh: 营地有热水淋浴,入口附近还有一家小商店。

caravan.en: We hired a caravan and drove along the coast for two weeks.
caravan.zh: 我们租了一辆房车,沿着海岸开了两周。

cabin.en: Each cabin on the ship has two beds and a small window.
cabin.zh: 船上每间船舱都有两张床和一扇小窗。

cabin.en: We stayed in a wooden cabin beside the lake for the weekend.
cabin.zh: 周末我们住在湖边的一间木屋里。

single-room.en: A single room costs £60 a night, including breakfast.
single-room.zh: 单人间每晚 60 英镑,含早餐。

double-room.en: We'd like a double room with a view of the garden, please.
double-room.zh: 我们想要一间能看到花园的大床双人间。

twin-room.en: My friend and I asked for a twin room with separate beds.
twin-room.zh: 我和朋友要了一间有两张床的双人间。

vacancy.en: Sorry, the hotel has no vacancies during the festival next week.
vacancy.zh: 抱歉,下周节日期间酒店没有空房。

check-in.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight and closes forty minutes before it.
check-in.zh: 值机在航班起飞前两小时开放,起飞前四十分钟关闭。

check-out.en: Check-out is at eleven, but you can leave your bags at the desk.
check-out.zh: 退房时间是十一点,但你可以把包寄存在前台。

reception.en: Please hand in your room key at reception when you leave.
reception.zh: 离开时请把房间钥匙交到前台。

reception.en: The wedding reception will be held in the hotel's main hall.
reception.zh: 婚礼招待会将在酒店的主厅举行。

receptionist.en: The receptionist gave us a map and showed us where to park.
receptionist.zh: 前台接待员给了我们一张地图,还告诉我们在哪里停车。

luggage.en: You can leave your luggage in this room until your bus arrives.
luggage.zh: 在你的巴士到来之前,可以把行李放在这个房间。

baggage-allowance.en: Your baggage allowance on this flight is twenty kilos per passenger.
baggage-allowance.zh: 这趟航班的行李限额是每位乘客二十公斤。

carry-on.en: You may take one carry-on bag and a small handbag on the plane.
carry-on.zh: 你可以带一个随身行李包和一个小手提包上飞机。

passport.en: Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months.
passport.zh: 请确保你的护照至少还有六个月有效期。

visa.en: Students from some countries need a visa before they can enter.
visa.zh: 来自部分国家的学生入境前需要办理签证。

customs.en: We had to open our suitcases when we went through customs.
customs.zh: 过海关时,我们不得不打开行李箱。

immigration.en: There was a long queue at immigration when we landed in Sydney.
immigration.zh: 我们在悉尼降落后,入境检查处排着长队。

boarding-pass.en: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready at the gate.
boarding-pass.zh: 请在登机口准备好登机牌和护照。

gate.en: Your flight to Rome will now leave from gate twelve.
gate.zh: 你飞往罗马的航班现在改从十二号登机口出发。

terminal.en: International flights leave from the new terminal on the other side of the airport.
terminal.zh: 国际航班从机场另一侧的新航站楼出发。

flight.en: My flight to Berlin leaves at seven tomorrow morning.
flight.zh: 我飞往柏林的航班明早七点起飞。

delay.en: There's a two-hour delay because of heavy snow at the airport.
delay.zh: 由于机场大雪,航班延误了两小时。

delay.en: Bad weather may delay the ferry, so please check before you leave.
delay.zh: 恶劣天气可能导致渡轮延误,所以出发前请查询。

transfer.en: The hotel offers a free transfer between the airport and the city centre.
transfer.zh: 酒店提供机场和市中心之间的免费接送。

transfer.en: You'll need to transfer to another train at the next station.
transfer.zh: 你需要在下一站换乘另一趟火车。

shuttle-bus.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the terminal and the car park.
shuttle-bus.zh: 航站楼和停车场之间有免费的接驳巴士。

coach.en: The coach to Oxford leaves from the bus station every half hour.
coach.zh: 开往牛津的长途汽车每半小时从汽车站发车。

coach.en: Our swimming coach makes us train three times a week.
coach.zh: 我们的游泳教练要我们每周训练三次。

ferry.en: The ferry to the island takes about forty minutes each way.
ferry.zh: 去岛上的渡轮单程大约四十分钟。

cruise.en: They went on a two-week cruise around the Mediterranean last summer.
cruise.zh: 去年夏天他们坐游轮环游了地中海,为期两周。

platform.en: The train to Manchester will now leave from platform six.
platform.zh: 开往曼彻斯特的列车现在改从六号站台发车。

timetable.en: Check the bus timetable because there are fewer services on Sundays.
timetable.zh: 看看公交时刻表,因为周日的班次较少。

single-ticket.en: A single ticket to the city centre costs two pounds fifty.
single-ticket.zh: 到市中心的单程票是两英镑五十便士。

return-ticket.en: A return ticket is usually cheaper than buying two singles.
return-ticket.zh: 买往返票通常比买两张单程票便宜。

fare.en: The bus fare has gone up by twenty pence since January.
fare.zh: 公交车费从一月起涨了二十便士。

concession.en: Students and pensioners can get a concession if they show their cards.
concession.zh: 学生和退休人员出示证件可享受优惠票价。

season-ticket.en: A monthly season ticket saves me quite a lot on my journey to work.
season-ticket.zh: 买月票让我上班路费省了不少。

underground.en: The quickest way to get to the museum is by underground.
underground.zh: 去博物馆最快的方式是坐地铁。

subway.en: Take the subway to Central Park and then walk for five minutes.
subway.zh: 乘地铁到中央公园,然后步行五分钟。

subway.en: Use the subway under the road to reach the other side safely.
subway.zh: 走马路下面的地下通道可以安全到达对面。

tram.en: You can take the tram from the station directly to the seafront.
tram.zh: 你可以从车站直接乘有轨电车到海滨。

cab.en: It was raining heavily, so we took a cab back to the hotel.
cab.zh: 雨下得很大,所以我们打车回了酒店。

motorway.en: Stay on the motorway until you see the sign for the airport.
motorway.zh: 沿高速公路一直开,直到看到机场的指示牌。

lane.en: Keep to the left lane when you reach the end of the bridge.
lane.zh: 到桥尽头时,请靠左侧车道行驶。

lane.en: The farm is at the end of a narrow lane behind the church.
lane.zh: 农场在教堂后面一条窄巷的尽头。

junction.en: Turn right at the next junction and the hotel is straight ahead.
junction.zh: 在下一个路口右转,酒店就在正前方。

roundabout.en: Go straight over the roundabout and take the second road on the left.
roundabout.zh: 直行穿过环岛,然后走左边第二条路。

crossroads.en: Turn left at the crossroads, just after the petrol station.
crossroads.zh: 过了加油站,在十字路口左转。

traffic-lights.en: Go straight on at the traffic lights and the bank is on your right.
traffic-lights.zh: 在红绿灯处直行,银行就在你右边。

pedestrian.en: This part of the town centre is open to pedestrians only.
pedestrian.zh: 市中心的这一部分只允许行人通行。

pavement.en: Please don't leave your bike on the pavement outside the shop.
pavement.zh: 请不要把自行车停在商店外的人行道上。

detour.en: The bridge is closed, so we had to make a long detour.
detour.zh: 桥封闭了,所以我们只好绕了很长一段路。

toll.en: Drivers have to pay a small toll to cross the new bridge.
toll.zh: 司机过这座新桥要交一小笔通行费。

landmark.en: The clock tower is the town's best-known landmark and is easy to find.
landmark.zh: 钟楼是这个小镇最著名的地标,很容易找到。

monument.en: The monument in the square was built to remember the city's founder.
monument.zh: 广场上的纪念碑是为纪念这座城市的创建者而建的。

souvenir.en: I bought a small painting as a souvenir of my trip to Peru.
souvenir.zh: 我买了一幅小画,作为秘鲁之行的纪念品。

currency.en: You can change your money into local currency at the airport.
currency.zh: 你可以在机场把钱换成当地货币。

exchange-rate.en: The exchange rate is usually better at a bank than at a hotel.
exchange-rate.zh: 银行的汇率通常比酒店的更划算。

insurance.en: Don't forget to buy travel insurance before you go skiing.
insurance.zh: 去滑雪之前别忘了买旅行保险。

sunscreen.en: Bring a hat and some sunscreen, as there's little shade on the island.
sunscreen.zh: 带上帽子和防晒霜,因为岛上没什么阴凉的地方。

first-aid-kit.en: Each group leader carries a first aid kit in case of accidents.
first-aid-kit.zh: 每位领队都带着急救包,以防发生意外。

binoculars.en: Remember to bring binoculars if you want to watch the birds.
binoculars.zh: 如果想观鸟,记得带双筒望远镜。

motel.en: We stopped at a roadside motel because we were too tired to drive.
motel.zh: 我们太累开不动了,就在路边的汽车旅馆停了下来。

inn.en: We had lunch at an old inn in the middle of the village.
inn.zh: 我们在村子中央的一家老旅馆吃了午饭。

lodge.en: The ski lodge is only a short walk from the slopes.
lodge.zh: 这家滑雪旅舍离雪道只有几步路。

castle.en: The castle is open to visitors every day except Monday.
castle.zh: 这座城堡除周一外每天对游客开放。

tent.en: Put up your tent before dark, as there are no lights at the site.
tent.zh: 天黑前把帐篷搭好,因为营地没有灯。

torch.en: You'll need a torch because the path to the beach has no lights.
torch.zh: 你需要带手电筒,因为去海滩的路上没有灯。

torch.en: Runners carried the Olympic torch through the city centre this morning.
torch.zh: 今天上午,跑步者手持奥运火炬穿过市中心。

flashlight.en: Keep a flashlight in the car in case you break down at night.
flashlight.zh: 在车里放一个手电筒,以防夜里抛锚。

metro.en: The metro runs until midnight and is the cheapest way to get around.
metro.zh: 地铁运行到午夜,是最便宜的出行方式。

tube.en: We took the tube from Victoria Station to the British Museum.
tube.zh: 我们从维多利亚站坐地铁去了大英博物馆。

tube.en: The water passes through a thin plastic tube into the tank.
tube.zh: 水通过一根细塑料管流入水箱。

yacht.en: You can hire a yacht with a crew for a day at the harbour.
yacht.zh: 你可以在港口租一艘配船员的游艇玩一天。

embark.en: Passengers may embark from two o'clock, and the ship sails at five.
embark.zh: 乘客两点可以开始登船,船五点起航。

takeoff.en: Please turn off your phones and fasten your seatbelts before takeoff.
takeoff.zh: 起飞前请关闭手机并系好安全带。

landing.en: The plane made a smooth landing in spite of the strong wind.
landing.zh: 尽管风很大,飞机还是平稳着陆了。

landing.en: The bathroom is on the first-floor landing, right next to the stairs.
landing.zh: 浴室在二楼的楼梯平台上,就在楼梯旁边。

berth.en: I booked a lower berth on the night train to Edinburgh.
berth.zh: 我订了去爱丁堡夜车的下铺。

sleeper.en: We took the overnight sleeper from London and arrived in Scotland at dawn.
sleeper.zh: 我们从伦敦坐夜间卧铺列车,黎明时到达苏格兰。

attendant.en: Ask the flight attendant if you need another blanket or a drink.
attendant.zh: 如果还需要毯子或饮料,可以问空乘人员。

inspector.en: The ticket inspector fined me because I had forgotten my student card.
inspector.zh: 查票员罚了我的款,因为我忘了带学生证。

stopover.en: There's a three-hour stopover in Dubai on the way to Australia.
stopover.zh: 去澳大利亚途中要在迪拜停留三小时。

avenue.en: The theatre is on Park Avenue, opposite the main post office.
avenue.zh: 剧院在公园大街,就在邮政总局对面。

boulevard.en: We walked along a wide boulevard lined with cafés and old trees.
boulevard.zh: 我们沿着一条宽阔的林荫大道走,路边都是咖啡馆和老树。

alley.en: The little café is hidden in an alley behind the market.
alley.zh: 这家小咖啡馆藏在市场后面的小巷里。

intersection.en: Turn left at the next intersection and look for a blue building.
intersection.zh: 在下一个十字路口左转,找一栋蓝色的建筑。

crosswalk.en: Always use the crosswalk when you get across this busy street.
crosswalk.zh: 过这条繁忙的街道时,一定要走人行横道。

scuba-diving.en: You'll need a short training course before you can go scuba diving.
scuba-diving.zh: 去水肺潜水之前,你需要上一个短期培训班。

hang-gliding.en: Hang-gliding is a popular activity on the hills above the town.
hang-gliding.zh: 悬挂滑翔是小镇上方山丘上一项很受欢迎的活动。

youth-hostel.en: The youth hostel offers cheap beds and a shared kitchen for guests.
youth-hostel.zh: 这家青年旅舍为客人提供便宜的床位和公用厨房。

charter-flight.en: The tour company has arranged a charter flight directly to the island.
charter-flight.zh: 旅行社安排了一架直飞该岛的包机。

economy-class.en: Seats in economy class are narrow, but the tickets are much cheaper.
economy-class.zh: 经济舱座位很窄,但机票便宜得多。

driving-licence.en: You must show your driving licence when you hire a car.

pedestrian-crossing.en: Stop at the pedestrian crossing and let people get across the road.
pedestrian-crossing.zh: 在人行横道前停车,让行人过马路。

cycle-lane.en: A new cycle lane now runs from the station to the university.
cycle-lane.zh: 现在有一条新的自行车道从车站通到大学。

ring-road.en: Take the ring road if you want to avoid the traffic in town.
ring-road.zh: 如果想避开市内的拥堵,就走环路。

dual-carriageway.en: Turn left at the roundabout, then follow the dual carriageway for two miles.
dual-carriageway.zh: 在环岛左转,然后沿双向分隔车道公路走两英里。

t-junction.en: Go to the end of this road and turn right at the T-junction.
t-junction.zh: 走到这条路的尽头,在丁字路口右转。

place-of-interest.en: The guidebook lists every place of interest within an hour of the city.
place-of-interest.zh: 指南列出了距离这座城市一小时车程内的所有名胜。

overseas.en: More of our customers are now choosing overseas holidays in winter.
overseas.zh: 现在越来越多的顾客在冬天选择去海外度假。

overseas.en: I'd like to work overseas for a year after I graduate.
overseas.zh: 我想毕业后去海外工作一年。

aisle.en: Would you prefer a seat by the window or on the aisle?
aisle.zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位?

tyre.en: We got a flat tyre on the way and had to call for help.
tyre.zh: 我们路上爆胎了,只好打电话求助。

baggage.en: Please collect your baggage from the belt in the arrivals hall.
baggage.zh: 请到到达大厅的传送带提取行李。

suitcase.en: My suitcase didn't arrive with me, so I reported it at the desk.
suitcase.zh: 我的手提箱没有和我一起到,所以我去服务台报告了。

trolley.en: You can use a trolley to carry your bags to the car park.
trolley.zh: 你可以用手推车把行李运到停车场。

lobby.en: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine and walk from there.
lobby.zh: 我们九点在酒店大堂见面,然后从那里走过去。

lobby.en: Farmers are trying to lobby the government for more financial support.
lobby.zh: 农民正在游说政府提供更多资金支持。

booth.en: You can buy tickets for the boat trip at the booth by the pier.
booth.zh: 你可以在码头旁的售票亭买游船票。

transit.en: Your bags may be delayed if you're in transit through a busy airport.
transit.zh: 如果你在繁忙的机场中转,行李可能会延误。

escort.en: A member of staff will escort you to the gate in a wheelchair.
escort.zh: 工作人员会用轮椅护送你到登机口。

hike.en: We went for a long hike in the hills on our last day.
hike.zh: 最后一天,我们去山里长途徒步了一次。

fortnight.en: We're going to Greece for a fortnight at the end of August.
fortnight.zh: 八月底我们要去希腊待两周。

traveller.en: This café is a favourite with travellers waiting for the morning ferry.
traveller.zh: 这家咖啡馆很受等早班渡轮的旅行者喜爱。

guide.en: Our guide told us a lot about the history of the old town.
guide.zh: 导游给我们讲了很多老城的历史。

guide.en: Small lights along the floor guide visitors through the dark cave.
guide.zh: 地面上的小灯引导游客穿过黑暗的洞穴。

dock.en: We walked down to the dock to watch the fishing boats come in.
dock.zh: 我们走到码头,看渔船进港。

dock.en: The ship will dock at eight, so you'll have all day to explore.
dock.zh: 船八点靠岸,所以你有一整天时间游览。

layout.en: The layout of the museum is confusing, so take a map with you.
layout.zh: 博物馆的布局容易让人迷路,所以带上一张地图。

entrance.en: The main entrance is on the north side of the building.

exit.en: The nearest exit is at the back of the hall, behind the stage.
exit.zh: 最近的出口在大厅后部,舞台后面。

opposite.en: The ticket office is directly opposite the main entrance of the park.
opposite.zh: 售票处就在公园正门的正对面。

opposite.en: Cross the road and wait for the bus on the opposite side.
opposite.zh: 过马路,在对面等公交车。

adjacent.en: The car park is adjacent to the museum, so you won't have far to walk.
adjacent.zh: 停车场紧邻博物馆,所以不用走很远。

diagonally.en: The café is diagonally across from the library, on the corner of the square.
diagonally.zh: 咖啡馆在图书馆的斜对面,位于广场的一角。

clockwise.en: Walk clockwise around the lake and you'll reach the boat house first.
clockwise.zh: 沿顺时针方向绕湖走,你会先到船屋。

anticlockwise.en: The route goes anticlockwise round the park, starting from the south gate.
anticlockwise.zh: 路线从南门出发,逆时针绕公园一圈。

north-east.en: The new sports hall is in the north-east of the campus.
north-east.zh: 新体育馆在校园的东北部。

south-west.en: The lake is in the south-west of the park, near the café.
south-west.zh: 湖在公园的西南部,靠近咖啡馆。

bend.en: Slow down here, because there's a sharp bend just after the bridge.
bend.zh: 这里请减速,因为过桥后有一个急转弯。

track.en: Follow the track through the woods until you reach the river.
track.zh: 沿着小道穿过树林,一直走到河边。

trail.en: The coastal trail takes about three hours and has wonderful views.
trail.zh: 这条海岸步道大约要走三小时,沿途风景很美。

footpath.en: A footpath leads from the car park down to the waterfall.
footpath.zh: 一条人行小径从停车场通向瀑布。

car-park.en: The car park behind the theatre is free after six o'clock.
car-park.zh: 剧院后面的停车场六点以后免费。

picnic-area.en: There's a picnic area with tables beside the pond.
picnic-area.zh: 池塘边有一个摆着桌子的野餐区。

viewpoint.en: From the viewpoint at the top, you can see the whole valley.
viewpoint.zh: 从山顶的观景点可以看到整个山谷。

lighthouse.en: The old lighthouse is now a small museum about life at sea.
lighthouse.zh: 这座旧灯塔现在是一座介绍海上生活的小博物馆。

pier.en: You can catch the boat from the end of the pier.
pier.zh: 你可以在栈桥尽头乘船。

harbour.en: Fishing boats were coming into the harbour as we had breakfast.
harbour.zh: 我们吃早餐时,渔船正驶入港口。

windmill.en: The old windmill on the hill was once used to grind flour.
windmill.zh: 山上那座旧风车过去用来磨面粉。

barn.en: The farm has turned its old barn into a café for visitors.
barn.zh: 农场把旧谷仓改成了接待游客的咖啡馆。

orchard.en: Visitors can pick their own apples in the orchard during September.
orchard.zh: 九月游客可以在果园里自己摘苹果。

pond.en: There are ducks on the pond in front of the old farmhouse.
pond.zh: 老农舍前的池塘里有鸭子。

fountain.en: Let's meet by the fountain in the middle of the square.
fountain.zh: 我们在广场中央的喷泉旁见面吧。

statue.en: The statue at the entrance shows the man who started the school.
statue.zh: 入口处的雕像塑的是这所学校的创办人。

gallery.en: The art gallery is free, but there's a charge for special exhibitions.
gallery.zh: 美术馆免费参观,但特别展览要收费。

auditorium.en: The talk has moved to the main auditorium because so many people signed up.
auditorium.zh: 报名的人太多,讲座改到了主礼堂。

pavilion.en: There's a small pavilion by the lake where you can sit in the shade.
pavilion.zh: 湖边有一座小亭子,你可以坐在里面乘凉。

block.en: The post office is two blocks from here, on your left.
block.zh: 邮局离这里两个街区,在你的左边。

block.en: Fallen trees may block the road after a heavy storm.
block.zh: 暴风雨过后,倒下的树可能会挡住道路。

gutter.en: Leaves had filled the gutter, so the rain ran across the road.
gutter.zh: 落叶堵满了排水沟,所以雨水流得满路都是。

moat.en: You have to cross a wooden bridge over the moat to enter the castle.
moat.zh: 要进入城堡,得走过护城河上的一座木桥。

arrow.en: Just follow the red arrows on the wall to find the exit.
arrow.zh: 只要跟着墙上的红色箭头走就能找到出口。

halfway.en: We stopped for lunch about halfway between London and Edinburgh.
halfway.zh: 我们在伦敦和爱丁堡之间大约中途的地方停下来吃午饭。

underneath.en: You'll find the toilets underneath the main stairs, next to the café.
underneath.zh: 洗手间在主楼梯下面,紧挨着咖啡馆。
